title: Services and Public Places
ringkas: Bank, kantor pos, klinik, dan layanan pelanggan
goals: membalas percakapan **di bank, kantor pos, klinik, dan layanan pelanggan**

lesson.text: Di tempat layanan, petugas bertanya hal yang mirip: apa tujuanmu, nama, nomor, dan tanggal. Siapkan balasan singkat dan jelas.

lesson.title: Ungkapan berguna
table: [[I'd like to make a complaint about ...]]

lines.en: Good morning. How can I help you?
lines.id: Selamat pagi. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

lines.en: I'd like to send this parcel to Bandung.
lines.id: Saya ingin mengirim paket ini ke Bandung.

lines.en: Regular, please. How long will it take?

lesson.title: Cara berlatih
lesson.text: Siapkan data penting dalam bahasa Inggris (nama, alamat, nomor telepon) dan latih mengejanya dengan keras.

items: Menyampaikan tujuan: [[I'd like to ... / I'm here to ...]]
Menjawab data: [[My name is ... / My number is ...]]
Mengeluh: [[I'd like to make a complaint about ...]]

practice.q: How can I help you today?
turns: How can I help you today?
answers: I'd like to open a savings account.
I want to open a savings account, please.
I'm here to open an account.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'd like to open a savings account.  atau  I want to open a savings account, please.  atau  I'm here to open an account.

practice.q: May I see your identity card?
turns: May I see your identity card?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Sure, here it is.  atau  Of course. Here you are.  atau  Yes, here's my ID.

practice.q: Could you spell your last name?
turns: Could you spell your last name?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Sure. It's S-A-N-T-O-S-O.  atau  Of course. S-A-N-T-O-S-O.  atau  Yes, S-A-N-T-O-S-O.
Contoh balasan: It's going to Surabaya.  atau  To Surabaya, please.  atau  Surabaya, please.

practice.q: That will be twenty thousand rupiah.
turns: That will be twenty thousand rupiah.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Can I pay by card?  atau  Do you accept cards?  atau  Is card OK?

practice.id: Katakan kamu punya janji pukul sepuluh.
answers: Yes, I have an appointment at ten.
Yes, at ten o'clock with Dr. Sari.
Yes, my appointment is at ten.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Yes, I have an appointment at ten.  atau  Yes, at ten o'clock with Dr. Sari.  atau  Yes, my appointment is at ten.

answers: I've had a fever since yesterday.
I have a fever and a headache.
I feel sick. I have a fever.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I've had a fever since yesterday.  atau  I have a fever and a headache.  atau  I feel sick. I have a fever.

practice.q: Are you allergic to any medicine?
turns: Are you allergic to any medicine?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: No, I'm not.  atau  No, I don't think so.  atau  No allergies.

practice.q: Thank you for calling. How can I help?
turns: Thank you for calling. How can I help?
answers: I'm calling about my order. It hasn't arrived.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: My package hasn't arrived yet.  atau  I'm calling about my order. It hasn't arrived.  atau  My order is late.

practice.q: Could you give me your order number?
turns: Could you give me your order number?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Yes, it's 12345.  atau  Sure, the number is 12345.  atau  It's 12345.

practice.id: Sampaikan keluhan tentang makanan yang dingin.
answers: I'd like to make a complaint. The food is cold.
The soup is cold. Could you change it?
My food is cold. I'm not happy.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'd like to make a complaint. The food is cold.  atau  The soup is cold. Could you change it?  atau  My food is cold. I'm not happy.

practice.id: Terima permintaan maaf dan minta ganti.
answers: Thank you. Could you bring a new one?
That's OK. Can I have a refund?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Thank you. Could you bring a new one?  atau  That's OK. Can I have a refund?  atau  Thanks. Please replace it.

answers: Could you explain how to fill it in?
Where should I write my address?
How do I fill in this part?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Could you explain how to fill it in?  atau  Where should I write my address?  atau  How do I fill in this part?
Contoh balasan: Thank you for your help.  atau  Thanks very much.  atau  Thank you.
